prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1095; do not mention it.)
text: Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of northbound Interstate 45 near the Conroe exit when traffic slowed for a merging vehicle. Driver 2 was following directly behind Driver 1 and did not stop in time, striking the rear of Driver 1's vehicle with its front bumper. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and reported neck discomfort at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and stated that the wrist struck the steering wheel upon impact. Driver 1 was conscious and responsive and was transported by EMS to a local hospital for evaluation. Both vehicles sustained rear and front-end damage and were towed from the scene. Driver 2 stated that the brakes did not respond quickly enough and admitted to following too closely. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry at the time of the collision.
